review-aim: Abstract, p.1: the last sentence states the aim of the article in the quoted words. Read in context.
mps-definition: Section II.A.1, p.7: the paper defines the MPS form (Eq. 1) for N sites of dimension d. The parameter count N d D^2 follows from D x D matrices per site and index, as stated in the same sentence.
quantum-simulator-definition: Section III.A, p.20: the sentence defines a quantum simulator in the quoted words, after the paper introduces the concept. Read in context.
digital-vs-analog-simulation: Section III.A, p.20: the paragraph says a simulation can be digital or analog, then defines each in the two quoted sentences. Both definitions match the value.
rydberg-blockade: Section III.A.4, p.25: the paper names the phenomenon as Rydberg blockade and explains it. Large dipole moment shifts nearby energy levels and prevents a second excitation within a radius. It is the paper's own use of the term.
quantum-computer-definition: Section III.B, p.26: the paper says what it means by a quantum computer, as a contrast with simulation platforms. The value matches the quoted sentence.
